steps.name: write_file
steps.input:
{
 "path": "programs/task-1e2fb04a.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    if len(pts) < 2:
        return out
    pts.sort()
    dr = pts[-1][0] - pts[-2][0]
    dc = pts[-1][1] - pts[-2][1]
    if dr == 0 and dc == 0:
        return out
    r, c = pts[-1]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    while 0 <= r + dr < h and 0 <= c + dc < w:
        r += dr
        c += dc
        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
"
}
